verdict.rationale: Square has a dedicated 'Idempotency' documentation page and its agent-facing llms.txt explicitly states 'every write endpoint accepts an idempotency key' to prevent duplicate charges from retries. This directly matches the story's core requirement. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer confirmation of idempotency behavior under real network-failure retries, and more detail on key expiration/scope beyond the doc title.
